card.name: Milligrams after acetaminophen 4000 limit
card.fires_on: The unit word (milligrams or mg) right after 4,000 in the liver-injury warning about acetaminophen doses exceeding the daily amount. It is followed by 'per day'.

modes.label: Spelled-out unit
modes.description: The end of 'milligrams' after 'mill' in the acetaminophen liver injury warning.
modes.example: associated with the use of acetaminophen at doses that exceed 4000 mill<<igrams>> per day, and often involve more than

modes.label: Abbreviated unit
modes.description: The abbreviation mg after 4,000 in the same warning sentence.
modes.example: associated with doses of acetaminophen that exceed 4,000<< mg>> per day, and often involve more than

card.writes: The promoted and suppressed tokens are mostly unrelated, so there is no clear output effect.
